ADVISOR SIGNOFF: APPROVED WITH BINDING AMENDMENTS — BUG-2221 SKETCH v1 by codex2 (/tmp/codex2-bug2221-sketch-v1.txt, canonical sketch comment). Advisor independently inspected current trace.rs collector817+, traversal124/173 and actual four-second SHOW_LINKAGE_DEADLINE. This authorizes implementation of the concrete algorithm, not completion or a budget waiver.
1. Negative proof semantics accepted: query identity includes exact Git-prefilter strings and parser versions; CLOSED ancestry requires each commit and every parent proved negative, never a tip-only inference. Git-owned root discovery must retain linked-worktree detached HEADs, annotated tags and actual all-root semantics. Positive matches stay on original date-order/parser/branch/shipped path. Exact batch accounting/framing, content-addressed evidence and before/after S/R checks are required; no guessed complete bit on missing/truncated/error or moving context. Unsupported shallow/graft/replace/semantic modes retain the bounded original query; no --no-replace-objects workaround or blind store subtraction.
2. Local disposable common-Git derived namespace accepted, with strict bounded owned no-follow files, atomic publication and nonblocking cache lock, separate from store/dispenser/policy locks and canonical graph. Add explicit PER-QUERY AND AGGREGATE bounds on bytes, nodes, pending entries and query count, plus deterministic safe eviction/reset that cannot traverse/unlink unowned paths or become a new daemon. A full/contended/corrupt cache degrades truthfully, never authorizes state or blocks canonical reads. Only digests of effective config/env; do not persist/log raw credentials or raw secret-bearing command diagnostics. Whole-query context capture and cache accounting are themselves inside bounded work.
3. Cold resumable unknown is accepted as an explicit cache-miss behavior ONLY with the existing truthful incomplete/shipped-unknown representation, no negative claim until all current roots close, and measurable eventual progress on repeated ordinary requests for a stable finite DAG. No background warmer/poller. Final results must report cold versus warm, complete versus incomplete, and positive versus negative cases. A perpetually partial fast path is not a repaired show command.
4. Foreground scheduling ruling:1000ms remains the performance objective, NOT permission to redefine success as cancelling formerly useful linkage at1000ms. Do not lower the existing four-second outer SHOW_LINKAGE_DEADLINE just to make guard samples green. Internal negative-proof batching can reserve measured canonical/render time and yield with truthful partial state, but a positive or unsupported-context fallback retains its existing bounded opportunity to produce the full answer; do not silently suppress it solely to satisfy the metric. Any additional deadline-policy change needs an explicit evidence-based ruling. Final acceptance requires the reproduced NORMAL DEFAULT shape under1000ms with warm COMPLETE semantically equivalent linkage, actual cold behavior, representative known-positive/unsupported cases, preserved formats and BUG1801 writer behavior; incomplete rates and reasons must be reported. If positive or remaining stages still miss target, continue the diagnosed repair rather than call it complete.
5. Single pristine clap tree and finer accounting accepted as first implementation slice; root inspected the redundant-tree proposal but no claim it explains all400ms. Preserve alias/human/agent/extension precedence, capability reparse, all aggregate phase meanings and security/freshness checks. No arbitrary store-HEAD memoization or new slow instrumentation default. Measure snapshot/cache cost and unnamed phases before fixing their cause.
6. Deadline-aware streaming traversal accepted: same deadline covers opening/iterating directories, descent, bounded reads and parsing; cycle fencing and in-root symlink alias display preserved, unfinished/refused/external traversal marked incomplete. Keep unbounded wrapper semantics for unrelated callers; do not change their behavior accidentally. Regex initialization once per process is acceptable.
7. Implement all three named slices and named DAG/ref/race/encoding/batch/cache-bound/traversal/dispatch/format fixtures from v1, including a code commit reachable from store+code, other-worktree detached HEAD and same relevant ref moving. Add aggregate-limit/flood and stable-DAG eventual-completion fixtures. Compare complete negative results against the original Git oracle; preserve positive order. Regression evidence must be structural/deterministic, not unexplained tight wall assertions. Local focused filtered tests+fast; touched/compile only shared infrastructure or>10files, Cargo background with AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT and no slot bypass/nested timeout/broad runtime.
8. Completion remains original full acceptance: clean normally reviewed PR(s), exact-head CI, pinned same-shape before/after default measurements, fresh lineage-scoped telemetry against unchanged1000ms/10percent/5000ms, no old sample deletion/relabel. No source slice alone completes BUG-2221. Existing BUG2222 fleet unblock/BUG2017 work and explicit new-head PR2919 review retain assigned priorities. Codex2 remains independent reviewer/sketch author; this signoff does not grant an implementer seat or authorize self-review.
subject: BUG2221 sketch signed with bounds and no deadline metric shortcut
